text:
Riley: hey all — quick question. Ive got 3 unused PTO days and my manager verbally said I can carry them into next year. Do I still need to file anything in the HR portal? Also our team is doing a voluntary "mini shutdown" Jan 3-5 (not the official company shutdown). Can I apply carryover to cover those days or is that considered a blackout?

Morgan (People Ops): hey Riley  short answer: yes, you need a formal carryover request in Workday. Manager verbal approval is fine but we need the record in the system. Mini team shutdowns are not company blackout days; you can request to use carryover to cover them if you get manager approval and submit before the payroll cutoff.

Riley: got it. payroll cutoff? and what if i miss the cutoff?

people_ops_bot: Reminder: PTO carryover processing cutoff is Dec 20 23:59 UTC. Requests after cutoff will require manual payroll adjustments in January and may delay balance updates. <https://hr.example.com/carryover>

Taylor: small nuance for folks on global contracts: if youre in UK/IE/FR we do local-law handling. Workday will show balances but local statutory carryover rules might apply. If your country has mandatory carryover limits, tag @People Ops.

Omar: 1 more edge case  Im switching teams and the new manager starts Jan 2. Who approves the carryover if approved verbally by old manager?

Morgan (People Ops): we prefer manager approval in the system from the manager responsible on the carryover effective date. If old manager approved and new manager is different, include both names in the Workday comments and cc people ops. Well reconcile during processing. If you cant get new manager signoff before Dec 20, file and ask us to hold for approval; we can route for expedited sign-off.

Riley: thanks  Ill submit now. will paste the request link here when done so you can see the comment.

Taylor: fyi for part-timers: accruals are pro-rated and Workday shows max carryover accordingly. If you think the math is off, screenshot the accrual history and ping @People Ops.

people_ops_bot: Case created: HR-5178 for Omar (transfer + carryover coordination).
